package com.acme.order.service;

import com.acme.order.domain.Order;
import com.acme.order.domain.OrderStatus;
import com.acme.order.domain.OrderSummary;
import com.acme.order.exception.OrderLimitExceededException;
import com.acme.order.exception.OrderNotFoundException;
import com.acme.order.exception.OutOfStockException;
import com.acme.order.notification.NotificationException;
import com.acme.order.notification.NotificationService;
import com.acme.order.notification.OrderEvent;
import com.acme.order.pricing.ShippingRateTable;
import com.acme.order.repository.OrderRepository;
import com.acme.order.service.command.PlaceOrderCommand;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
@Transactional
public class OrderServiceImpl implements OrderService {

    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(OrderServiceImpl.class);

    /** Orders above this many units must go through the bulk channel. */
    static final int MAX_QUANTITY = 100;
    static final int PREMIUM_SURCHARGE_CENTS = 350;
    static final BigDecimal CREDIT_LIMIT = new BigDecimal("5000.00");

    private final OrderRepository orderRepository;
    private final InventoryService inventoryService;
    private final NotificationService notifier;

    public OrderServiceImpl(final OrderRepository orderRepository,
                            final InventoryService inventoryService,
                            final NotificationService notifier) {
        this.orderRepository = orderRepository;
        this.inventoryService = inventoryService;
        this.notifier = notifier;
    }

    @Override
    public Order placeOrder(final PlaceOrderCommand command) {
        if (command == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("command must not be null");
        }
        if (command.quantity() > MAX_QUANTITY) {
            throw new OrderLimitExceededException(command.quantity(), MAX_QUANTITY);
        }
        if (!inventoryService.reserve(command.sku(), command.quantity())) {
            throw new OutOfStockException(command.sku());
        }

        BigDecimal total = command.unitPrice().multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(command.quantity()));
        Order order = Order.newOrder(command.customerId(), command.sku(), command.quantity(), total);
        if (total.compareTo(CREDIT_LIMIT) > 0) {
            order.setStatus(OrderStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL);
        } else {
            order.setStatus(OrderStatus.CONFIRMED);
        }

        Order saved = orderRepository.save(order);
        try {
            notifier.send(OrderEvent.placed(saved.getId(), saved.getCustomerId()));
        } catch (NotificationException ex) {
            // never roll back a paid order because of e-mail; the outbox relay retries { see OutboxRelay }
            log.warn("order {} saved but notification failed: {}", saved.getId(), ex.getMessage());
        }
        return saved;
    }

    @Override
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Order getOrder(final Long orderId) {
        return findOrderOrThrow(orderId);
    }

    @Override
    public Order cancelOrder(final Long orderId, final String reason) {
        Order order = findOrderOrThrow(orderId);
        switch (order.getStatus()) {
            case PENDING_APPROVAL:
                order.setStatus(OrderStatus.CANCELLED);
                break;
            case CONFIRMED:
                inventoryService.release(order.getSku(), order.getQuantity());
                order.setStatus(OrderStatus.CANCELLED);
                break;
            case SHIPPED:
                throw new IllegalStateException("order " + orderId + " already shipped; raise a return instead");
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("cannot cancel order in status " + order.getStatus());
        }
        order.setCancellationReason(reason == null ? "unspecified" : reason);
        Order saved = orderRepository.save(order);
        notifier.send(OrderEvent.cancelled(saved.getId(), saved.getCustomerId()));
        return saved;
    }

    @Override
    public int calculateFee(final int zone, final int weightGrams) {
        final int base = ShippingRateTable.feeFor(zone, weightGrams);
        return ShippingRateTable.isPremiumZone(zone) ? base + PREMIUM_SURCHARGE_CENTS : base;
    }

    @Override
    public int discountFor(final int quantity) {
        if (quantity > 50) {
            return 500;
        } else if (quantity >= 10) {
            return 250;
        } else {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    @Override
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<OrderSummary> listOpenOrders(final String customerId) {
        return orderRepository.findByCustomerId(customerId).stream()
                .filter(Order::isOpen)
                .map(OrderSummary::from)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    private Order findOrderOrThrow(final Long orderId) {
        return orderRepository.findById(orderId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> {
                    log.info("order {} not found", orderId);
                    return new OrderNotFoundException(orderId);
                });
    }
}
